_comment: Contract artifact documenting the notification module's frontend routes/nav for the module validator. The actual TypeScript/React source lives under web/shell/src/modules/notification/ rather than this directory's own src/: there is no remote-module-loading mechanism, so the shell's local module registry (web/shell/src/modules/registry.ts) is the only frontend distribution path a module has today.
_featureKeyComment: Routes gate on 'notification.access' (the generic <moduleKey>.access key internal/authz/summary.go synthesizes for any enabled module at company scope) rather than authz.fragment.json's fine-grained 'notification.inbox.view'/'notification.channels.manage': the fragment-declared keys are not loaded into the live authz engine, so they are never granted to anyone.
